frozen_before: All v98 supervised training and confirmation
representation: 1283 deterministic ETKDGv3 conformer descriptors plus 435 existing 2D descriptors; optional target-excluded exact/neutral-parent other-task assays and baseline rank
data: Official training/validation labels only; test structures from the template. No external datasets or new pretrained weights.
selection: Choose one configuration per task by maximum minimum gain in fold0/fold1, requiring >1% relative MAE improvement, >0.005 Spearman, or >0.002 AUC/AP in each development fold.
confirmation: Freeze before fold2/valid. All four gains must be strictly positive and their mean exceed the metric threshold. No fallback or confirmation-based retuning.
assembly_with_v97: Take the union of accepted task experts from v95/v96/v98, each applied once to v94. If several branches accept the same task, choose greater minimum fold0/fold1 development gain; break an exact tie by lower version number. Do not blend multiple experts for the same task or choose by confirmation gain.
limitations: Historically reused proxy labels and an approximate v94 baseline; synthetic conformers are approximations. Local gains do not estimate platform gains.
